notes: This inventory records source-backed intended behavior; no application flow, provider payment, blockchain operation, or test was executed.
Native/mobile parity is intentionally unknown here unless independently checked; merge native findings by capability rather than assuming absence.
Team labels are inferred functional streams from test annotations, not confirmed product ownership or individual assignments.
Manual scenarios are skipped test containers containing instructions, not automatically executable coverage or evidence of a passing run.
Individual label-edit operations and BIP329 account imports/exports belong to the wallet inventory to avoid duplicate canonical nodes.
Internal referral functionality is a debug-gated mock prototype; the dashboard external referral entry is separate.
Suite Sync debug relay/quota wipe controls, custom Tron representative editing in debug mode, and Connect silent mode in debug mode are excluded from ordinary user features.
Password manager is experimental and provider-dependent; no claim is made that the former webextension or its service remains generally supported.
No current screenshots were captured; existing documentation images were not treated as evidence of present UI.
WalletConnect Solana and Tron message-signing names are advertised for compatibility but throw unsupported errors; Bitcoin PSBT signing is also not currently supported.
Trading region restrictions, provider country/state eligibility, network fees, token approvals, device capabilities, and message-system feature disabling materially constrain availability.

Every manual connect and trading file was reconciled against the feature inventory. Named external wallets and dApps are recorded in integration_examples as intended compatibility scenarios, not separate Suite core features or executed certifications.

Manual trading backend instructions conditionally mention a KYC offer filter. The current TradingOffersModalExchange renders only All/CEX/DEX filters, so an unsupported KYC filter was not added as a current feature.
Manual Rabby desktop and Jupiter-mobile scenarios contain platform/network wording inconsistencies. integration_examples retains these conflicts instead of asserting corrected compatibility.
Current getSupportsAdjustableFees excludes native Tron and Solana fee pickers while permitting eligible Tron token transfers; fixed provider fees also suppress editing.
The wallet-trade account embedded form route is explicitly debug-only in WalletTradePage and is excluded from regular contextual trading entry points.

All service routes in routeConfig were checked: buy/sell/swap forms, confirmations, approval, provider redirect, history, concierge, Earn yield actions, Tron lifecycle, connected apps, password manager, and referral are represented. Technical redirects are not independent user capabilities.

External transaction/message review components are shared by Connect and WalletConnect. They are canonically parented directly under Connected applications; stable IDs retain their earlier walletconnect namespace and do not define the hierarchy.
